# PROOFS - the claim ledger

Every public claim in this repo carries a receipt ID. Replay them from the repo root:

```
bash tools/prove/prove.sh          # fast tier (default, seconds)
bash tools/prove/prove.sh --core   # + R01 fixed point (~11 min) + R02 suite (~17 min)
bash tools/prove/prove.sh R10      # a single claim
bash tools/prove/prove.sh --all    # everything, including gated tiers
```

Tiers: fast (default) / core / net / gpu / key / hw. GATED claims print SKIP with the
reason unless their tier flag is passed. Est times are estimates and never gate.
